name: Feature Plan & Implement
description: Break down a feature request into atomic tasks, list dependencies, produce a verification checklist, and suggest tests to add.

steps.title: Gather context
steps.description: Inspect README, ARCHITECTURE.md, and relevant modules to collect context.

steps.title: Create atomic tasks
steps.description: Break the feature into 15-minute atomic tasks and order by dependency.

steps.title: Identify tests & verification
steps.description: Define unit/integration tests to prove correctness.

steps.title: Implement & run tests
steps.description: Apply minimal changes and run tests locally.

steps.title: Produce changelog and PR summary
steps.description: Create a changelog entry and PR description with verification steps.
